subject: Post-call: OliveTech pilot — propose time-swap windows for technical deep-dive
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Desai <priya@olivetech.com>, Tom Walsh <tom.walsh@olivetech.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: OliveTech pilot — propose time-swap windows for technical deep-dive

Hi Priya / Tom — thanks again for a productive discovery earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next step: a 90-minute technical deep-dive (infrastructure + security + SE demo) to validate latency, tenant isolation, and integration hooks for your pilot.

Key notes from discovery:
- Pilot scope: 50k monthly inference requests, mixed short chat + single-shot summarization flows.
- Compliance: SOC 2 in progress; you flagged strict tenant separation and audit log retention.
- Integrations: internal SSO and S3-compatible object store for artifacts.

As discussed, we think a rotating meeting window that alternates across US / EU / APAC-friendly times will make it easier for your cross-regional team to attend without overnights. Proposed rhythm (we can run this as a pilot for 3 meetings then revisit):

Option 1 — US-friendly week (preferred for your infra team):
- Wed 16:00–17:30 UTC (US morning, EU late morning, APAC late evening)
Option 2 — EU-friendly week (preferred for security):
- Thu 13:00–14:30 UTC (US early morning, EU afternoon, APAC late night)
Option 3 — APAC-friendly week (rotate once per month):
- Tue 04:00–05:30 UTC (US late evening, EU early morning, APAC mid-day)

Please indicate which option you prefer and any calendar constraints. If helpful, I can create a rotating 3-week calendar series (we’ll mark timezone-friendly week labels in the invite). For immediate scheduling you can pick a slot on my public rotation page: https://cal.com/mateo/olivetech-rotation?tz=auto

Attached: post-call deck and a lightweight tenant scope matrix to help your security reviewers. Next steps I propose:
- You confirm preferred rotation (Option 1/2/3) and attendees (specifically the security lead + infra engineer + a prod PM).
- We send formal calendar invites with a 90-minute agenda and pre-reads (deck + scope matrix).
- Security sends a short list of SOC2/infosec artifacts they'd like in advance — we’ll surface what we can share immediately.

Thanks — happy to adapt.

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
mateo@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: olive_postcall_deck.pdf, tenant_scope_matrix.xlsx

- Preference: Option 2 (EU-friendly week) works best for our security and compliance reviewers. If we need occasional US-friendly slots for deeper infra demos, we can mark those as ad-hoc.
- Attendees: I will bring our Security Lead (Priyanka Rao), Infra Engineer (Tom Walsh), and the Product Manager (Samir Khan). Tom may ask to occasionally swap to an APAC-friendly slot when our Singapore office needs to join.
- Pre-reads: Security will need the tenant scope matrix and a short note on data residency/retention. Can you also include a short checklist for test data (PII redaction guidance)?

We have availability the week of Oct 19 in the following ranges (all local times shown as UTC+1):
- Tue 13:00–15:30
- Wed 09:00–11:30
- Thu 14:00–16:30

I’ll also drop a HubSpot note on the deal with our internal procurement lead. Deal id: DEAL-OLV-1427.
